RESIDENTS' GARDEN ROTA

Summer season

Members water the raised beds on their assigned mornings before nine o'clock.

The tool shed key hangs on the hook beside the gate and goes back there after use.

Compost goes in the left bin only; the right bin is kept for leaves and cuttings.

Swaps between members are fine when both agree and the rota sheet is updated.

Questions go to the garden coordinator.
